name: Deep Dominion
description: A campaign about growing from a hidden dungeon heart into a realm-spanning dark empire.
epilogue: The last light is out. The sunlit kingdoms kneel to a heart that beats beneath the mountain.
Where a lone dungeon once hid in the dark, an empire of tunnels, chambers and hungry things now stands.
The deep is yours. Deep, and forever.

missions.name: Dark Beginnings
missions.briefing: Carve your first chambers, attract a fighting force, and break the hero foothold before the surface rallies.

missions.name: Blood and Iron
missions.briefing: An armed force is worth ten hungry mouths. Drill your creatures, wall your approaches, and let the next patrol break itself on your doors.

missions.name: The Long Dark
missions.briefing: Steel rusts; gold endures. Sink shafts to the deep seams, turn your workshops to war, and out-earn the rival festering to the east — starve him and he falls without a fight.

missions.name: No Prisoners
missions.briefing: Death wastes a good soldier. Take them alive, break them in the dark, and send them back against their own as skeletons and turncoats.

missions.name: Whispers in the Circle
missions.briefing: Power sleeps in the old circles. Bind it, and call down lightning on any hero fool enough to march in the open.

missions.name: The Kennels
missions.briefing: An empire needs teeth. Fill the kennels, man the barracks, and keep the pay flowing — a hungry horde turns on the hand that starves it.

missions.name: The Restless Dead
missions.briefing: Let no corpse go to waste. Raise the fallen as vampires and drown the surface in a tide that does not tire and does not fear.

missions.name: Pacts and Sacrifice
missions.briefing: The old powers trade in blood. Feed the temple, bind the succubi and the demon-spawn, and buy an army no mortal treasury could afford.

missions.name: The Iron Siege
missions.briefing: They come in their hundreds now, sure the dark can be dug out like a splinter. Turn every corridor into a grave and teach the Kingdoms the cost of digging too deep.

missions.name: Corruption Rising
missions.briefing: No more waiting in the dark. March on the border town, corrupt its fields, pull down its church and its mage-spire, and let the surface feel the ground rot beneath them.

missions.name: Two Kings Under the Mountain
missions.briefing: The deep is not big enough for three hearts. Two other keepers scrabble for the same veins — expand faster, hit harder, and leave only your heart beating in the dark.

missions.name: The Gates of Heaven's Reach
missions.briefing: Heaven's Reach has never fallen. Break the gate, scatter its captains, and carve a road to the heart of the Sunlit Kingdoms.

missions.name: Deep Dominion
missions.briefing: They send their brightest against you — the Champion of Light, and all the host of the Sunlit Kingdoms. Endure their fury, then walk into their capital and put out the last light.
